title: Hearty Herbal Moroccan Lamb Briouat
description: A traditional Moroccan dish featuring lamb, pecan nuts, and kombu cold extract, wrapped in a flaky briouat pastry, served in a cazuela vessel. This ayurvedic-rajasic-friendly recipe is perfect for a midnight craving.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for an additional minute.
Add the lamb pieces and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the kombu cold extract, salt, and black pepper.
Roll out the briouat pastry and cut into squares.
Place a tablespoon of the lamb mixture onto the center of each square, followed by a sprinkle of chopped pecan nuts.
Fold the pastry into triangles and press the edges to seal.
Place the briouat in a cazuela vessel and bake for 25 minutes.
